name: Shoukoujo Charlotte "Goshujin-sama no Shojo Ningyou"
original_name: 小公女シャルロット「ご主人様の処女人形」
source:
The main character is from a rich family, but his parents passed away in an accident a while ago. He now lives a decadent life.... There are a lot of maids at his house. Some of them work there just for money while some want to have his baby.... One day, a new maid comes to his house. She is quiet and reserved, but she works hard every day. He gradually gets attracted to her pureness.... But one night, the girl suddenly comes to his room and says, "I'd like your semen...." "You're the same! You just want my money!" Since then, he just has sex with her day and night.... Her name is Charlotte....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角出身于一个富裕的家庭，但他的父母前段时间在一次事故中去世了。他现在过着颓废的生活……他家里有很多丫鬟。他们中的一些人在那里工作只是为了钱，而另一些人则想生他的孩子…… 有一天，一位新女佣来到了他家。她安静、矜持，但每天都努力工作。他渐渐被她的纯洁所吸引……但有一天晚上，女孩突然来到他的房间说：“我想要你的精液……”“你也一样！你只是想要我的钱！”从此以后，他就日夜与她做爱……她的名字叫夏洛特……

[来自工口游戏商店]
